context: Sakura's book is being translated to a foreign language.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: レン兄ちゃん、外国に、本、訳される。
lines.en: Ren — my book is getting translated overseas.
lines.style: Soft opening, letting the news land gently. Warm pride underneath, but held lightly. No performance — just sharing something real with someone who matters. Voice stays steady, almost tender.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Genuine surprise that becomes wonder. Slight breathlessness on the first word. Leans forward emotionally. The repetition isn't filler — it's him checking that he heard right, warm admiration flooding in.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夢、海、越える、感じ、本当に。
lines.en: It feels like — like my dream is crossing the ocean. Actually crossing it.
lines.style: Pause after the first dash. Thoughtful, almost amazed at the reality of it. Voice softens on 'ocean' — there's something poetic underneath his quiet delivery. Trailing slightly, like he's still processing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: お前の作品、世界、本当、繋がる。
lines.en: Your work — it's actually connecting with the whole world.
lines.style: Steady conviction underneath the gentleness. Not lecturing — witnessing something he sees clearly. Warm, reverent almost. Each phrase lands with quiet weight. Eye-contact level in his voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Simple, unguarded. No elaboration needed. Voice catches slightly — genuine emotion surfacing. Quiet exhale before the second sentence, like he's making sure the gratitude actually lands.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一緒に、ここまで、来た、宝、本当に。
lines.en: We got here together. That's the real treasure.
lines.style: Slower pace. Each phrase deliberately chosen. Soft but firm — this is what matters to him and he's saying it clearly. Voice stays warm, almost protective of the moment. Trailing slightly on 'treasure.'

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: これからも、頑張る、本当に。
lines.en: I'm going to keep going. Really going to.
lines.style: Determined but not loud. Quiet commitment. Voice tightens slightly on the promise, like he's pledging it to the moment and to Sakura both. Ends still warm, closing a circle they opened together.
